definitions.explanation: Something done or prepared immediately without advance planning. Used both for physical products (instant food) and for actions done spontaneously (impromptu speeches, offhand performances).

examples.japanese: {即席|そくせき}⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{即席|そくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}まれた→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
examples.english: I was asked to give an impromptu speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}り{物|もの}→残り物：18299_nokorimono⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{即席|そくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{意外|いがい}→意外：12741_igai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{美味|おい}しかった→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧。
examples.english: I made an impromptu dish from leftovers, and it turned out surprisingly good.

notes:
{即席|そくせき} means instant or impromptu — something done or prepared on the spot without advance planning. It covers two main uses: instant food products and spontaneous actions.

USAGE:
Functions as a noun modifier using ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or by direct compounding: {即席|そくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧～ or {即席|そくせき}～.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即席|そくせき}めん: instant noodles
- {即席|そくせき}⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧: instant ramen
- {即席|そくせき}⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: quick/improvised cooking
- {即席|そくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧: impromptu performance
- {即席|そくせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧: impromptu speech
- {即席|そくせき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make on the spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦インスタント→インスタント：10719_insutanto⟧: instant (mainly for food products, from English)
- {急|きゅう}ごしらえ: hastily prepared, makeshift
- とっさ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: spur-of-the-moment, reflexive
